preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the MARSINU contract.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setTaxFeePercent` function with the parameter 50, and then call the `setLiquidityFeePercent` function with the parameter 50. This will set the total transfer fees to 100%, effectively preventing any user from transferring their tokens as the entire amount is consumed by fees.
